IBM Announces Breakthrough in Sub-1 Nanometer Chip Technology

IBM has announced the development of what it claims is the world's first chip technology below 1 nanometer. This advancement is expected to lead to faster and more efficient computing, particularly for applications in artificial intelligence and cloud computing. While the technology represents a significant breakthrough, IBM indicates that it will take some time before it is ready for mass production.
